text:
Anya: Quick ask — need two LinkedIn carousels + one X thread to amplify the webinar next Wed. Audience A = startup founders/PMs (benchmark story), Audience B = platform/infra (cost/latency wins). Goal: registrations + demo CTAs. Can we do Variant A (story-led) and Variant B (feature-led) for each audience? :rocket:

Sam: Got it. I can draft copy. Would like to see slide count — 4 vs 6? also need hero image for both cohorts. I'll post copy drafts in a doc shortly.

Marta: 6 slides max per carousel please (keeps retention). Specs: 1200x1200, PNG or high-res JPG. Brand: use the new blue overlay (see brand kit) and avoid long paragraphs. Can we get alt text for accessibility?

Devon: I can take the carousel designs. Need final copy + hero image by Tue EOD to hit Wed launch. Any preferences on logo lockup? full logo on slide 1, compact on slide 6.

Luke: For tracking, use UTM template:```?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=webinar_q2&utm_content={cohort}_{variant}```Example: ?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=webinar_q2&utm_content=founders_A. Also please set landing page query param: source=social to help funnel.

Anya: Perfect — timeline: Tue EOD copy & assets, Wed morning scheduling, Wed afternoon live. For X thread we want a 6-tweet thread: 1) hook with benchmark stat, 2-4) problem + how we benchmarked, 5) outcome, 6) CTA to register. Keep it punchy.

Sam: Draft copy uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleLink — file names: "LD_copy_founders_A_v1.md" and "LD_copy_platform_B_v1.md". Feedback welcome. :eyes:

Marta: Reviewed copy — tighten the CTAs. Suggest replacing "learn more" with "save your seat". Also add slide-level microcopy for each image (one line).

Devon: Picking up assets from the drive now. @Sam can you add image captions and alt text directly in the doc? saves time.

Sam: On it. Adding alt text + slide microcopy. Also uploading 9:16 short motion clip for X (15s) that we can use as a promo.

Luke: We should stagger posts: LinkedIn carousel morning (10:00 PT), X thread at 11:00 PT, and a boosted post (paid) at 15:00 PT targeted to founders in SF / NYC. Any objections?

Anya: No objections. Schedule window approved. @SchedBot can you reserve 10:00–11:30 PT for us and flag any calendar conflicts? :calendar:

SchedBot: Reservation made — Posting window reserved 10:00–11:30 PT on Wed. Reminder set for Tue 3pm to finalize assets.

Devon: Draft carousels uploaded to drive > /designs/carousels/ — filenames: founders_A_final.png, platform_B_draft.png. Need final sign-off from Marta before export.

Marta: Reviewed platform_B — needs tighter headers on slides 2 and 3. I'll leave comments in Figma and approve once updated.

Sam: Manual follow-up plan: SDRs to triage high-intent commenters within 24h. I'll tag the SDR channel and paste a comment script. Also suggest we capture engaged leads via lead-gen form link in slide 6.

Anya: Love it. Post-launch ops: Sam to compile top commenters, Devon to generate short clips for retargeting, Marta to QA creative final exports. I'll own registration reporting and handoff to SDRs. :thumbsup:

Luke: One last ask — please include these UTM variations in the scheduling sheet: founders_A, founders_B, platform_A, platform_B. I'll wire them to the paid campaign.

Sam: Done — added a column in the scheduler sheet with exact URLs.

Anya: Thanks team — can we do a final sync Tue 4pm quick call? 15 minutes to sign off everything.

Marta: Works for me.

Devon: Works. Will have exports ready.

Luke: I'll be there.

SchedBot: Quick sync added to calendar Tue 16:00 PT • 15m — attendees: Anya, Sam, Marta, Devon, Luke.
